description: This file declares functions for parsing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, as well as a function for converting IPv6 addresses to string representations. It is part of a network-related module within the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into numerical form. Supports optional netmask and port parameters.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv6
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into binary form. Supports optional network and port parameters.

methods.name: li_ipv6_tostring
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address in binary form to its string representation, appending it to the provided GString.
